title: Executive at AI Company Expects Docusign Business to Grow 7% in 2026 and Retain or Slightly Gain Share
expert: Executive at an AI company; ex-president of two U.S. BPO firms (17+ yrs); manages 38 Docusign deployments across 200+ clients
verdict: The expert's own Docusign-related business rose about 5% y/y in Aug–Oct 2026 on 4%–6% higher renewal spend, with calendar 2026 tracking ~7%, still short of double digits.

Back to double-digit growth: 🟡 **Business up about 5% y/y** in Aug–Oct 2026, deal closures ~5.5% above prior year; first read from a partner on this measure.
🟡 **About 7% for calendar 2026** (estimate), above the expert's 5%–5.5% initial view but below double digits.
IAM adoption: 🟢 **About 40% of deals involve AI** vs 15%–20% a year ago.
🟡 **CLM adoption up about 5%–6%**; Cleveland saw net-new CLM deal volume down Y/Y (SB #63588): **conflicting**.
DBNR / renewal expansion: 🟢 **Renewal spend 4%–6% higher** as customers add Agreement Manager and ID verification; Cleveland put IAM ACV uplift at the high end of ~5-10% (SB #63574): consistent.
🟡 **Net pricing up about 4%–5%** (estimate), while terms shorten to 2+1 / 3+1 years from five.

changes: Renewal spend 4%–6% higher (expert) vs Cleveland IAM ACV uplift at the high end of ~5-10% (SB #63574): consistent.
CLM adoption up about 5%–6% (expert) vs Cleveland net-new CLM deal volume down Y/Y (SB #63588): conflicting.
First read on partner-level Docusign business growth (+~5% y/y); no earlier expert call or stored row.
thesis_impact: Stance (neutral; DD growth on the IAM bet): → — partner business +~5% and CY26 ~7% (estimate) is not yet double digits.
Stance (IAM bet): ↑ — about 40% of deals involve AI vs 15%–20% a year ago; renewals expand 4%–6%.
